message.reasoning:
We need to decide a post-turn action. Player Alpha has cash 350. Holdings: reading railroad, electric company, and three orange properties (St James Place, Tennessee Avenue, New York Avenue) each with 2 houses. Buildable spaces are those three (they have houses, can build more up to 4 houses before hotel). Each has 2 houses now, can add up to 2 more houses each (max 4). Bank has 18 houses remaining, 12 hotels. Building houses costs: each house on orange set costs $100? Actually in Monopoly, St James Place $180, Tennessee $180, New York $200. House cost is $100 per house for orange set. So each house costs $100. So building a house on each would cost $100. They have cash 350, could build up to 3 houses (cost 300) leaving 50. Could also mortgage electric company (value? Electric Company mortgage value $75). Reading Railroad mortgage $100. Could also consider building houses to increase rent. Opponents: Beta has 3 light blues? Actually Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois are orange? Wait those are red? Actually Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois are red set. Beta has those three red properties, each with 0 houses. So Beta could develop red set. Gamma has no holdings, on Boardwalk. Delta has cash 1020, no holdings.

Alpha's orange set with 2 houses each is decent. Could build more houses to increase rent, especially against Beta who may land on them. Also could mortgage electric company to get cash for houses. But we have enough cash to build 3 houses. Maybe build one house on each of the three orange properties (to keep even development). That would cost $300, leaving $50. That seems good.

Alternatively could build a hotel on one property after reaching 4 houses, but need 4 houses first. Not possible now.

Mortgage property: could mortgage electric company for $75, but we have cash already.

Thus best action: build houses. Build plan: for each of the three spaces, add 1 house. Build_houses_or_hotel action expects array of build_plan objects with count, kind, space_key. Count is number of houses/hotels to add? Probably count = number of houses to add. So each plan: count:1, kind:"HOUSE", space_key:"ST_JAMES_PLACE", etc.

Public message: maybe say "Building up my orange set." Could be friendly.

Make tool call.
